data.body: The first close attempt was rejected before LLM execution because the checkbox edit passed ticket JSON through RTK filtered jq output. The filtered string shortened the description from 3898 to 2533 characters. I restored the reviewed description from event d20a106f-74a5-4eb9-99ec-0d8f85cc879b and checked its fourteen acceptance criteria with pass-through jq. The restored event contains 3898 characters, fourteen checked criteria, and no unchecked criteria. A byte comparison after normalizing checkbox state matches the reviewed event. No force was used.
